subject: SILENT DATA LOSS (pre-existing, everyday file I/O): `binmode($h, ":utf8")` through a COPY of a lexical filehandle (a helper sub\x27s `my ($h) = @_`, or `my $g = $fh`) leaves every OTHER name for the handle on a CLOSED stream -- the caller\x27s later `print $fh` writes nothing and its `close` flushes nothing
